troubleshooting.title: Rebase or Merge Is Blocked
troubleshooting.shortdesc: The Git Client will not start a rebase or merge while conflicts or uncommitted changes are outstanding, or when the Git configuration forbids the merge.

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: A rebase or merge does not start, or it stops immediately.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: There are unresolved conflicts from an earlier operation, or uncommitted changes that the operation would overwrite.

step.cmd: Resolve any outstanding conflicts and finish the in-progress operation.
Commit or stash your uncommitted changes.
Start the rebase or merge again.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: The Git configuration forbids the merge, and the Git Client reports that the merge was not performed. Under merge.ff = only, a merge of branches that have diverged is refused. A is refused under merge.ff = false.
cause.note: This setting is often in ~/.gitconfig, where it applies to every repository on the machine rather than only to the current one.

step.cmd: Change the merge.ff setting, or remove it to restore the Git default.
Alternatively, run a merge that the configuration permits.

info.p: Under merge.ff = only, pull or rebase first so that the branches no longer diverge.
